Specification: This module specifies voucher cancellation between a Voucher Transaction Provider (VTP), voucher holders, and voucher issuers using a simplified Two-Phase Commit protocol. The model represents messages as elements of a growing set, lets holders and issuers spontaneously prepare or abort, and lets the VTP either cancel once all parties are prepared or spontaneously abort the transaction. The specification checks a type-correctness invariant and a consistency invariant stating that a holder and an issuer never end in conflicting cancelled/aborted decisions, and it also states that this protocol specification implements an imported voucher life cycle specification.

DivisionNotes: VTPTypeOK and VTPConsistent are Boolean-valued operators over the current state with no primed variables and no temporal operators, so they are classified as StatePredicate.
VTPSpec is a temporal property because its body is `VTPInit /\ [][VTPNext]_VTPVars`; Spec-like operators always belong in TemporalProperty.
Messages and VTPVars are placed in ValueDef because they define, respectively, a message-set value and the tuple variable vector, and are neither actions, state predicates, nor temporal properties.
